description: Request access to a private library or workflow you cannot see, or — as the resource owner — list, approve, or deny pending requests. Use action="request" when a loaded workflow reports a locked library (see its requestAccess affordance). This works from the terminal — the user does not need to open the web app.

action.description: request = ask for access; list = see requests (yours, or a resource's if you own it); approve/deny = resolve a request you own.

mine.description: For action=list: list your own requests instead of a resource's pending requests.

rejectionReason.description: Optional reason shown to the requester (action=deny).

requestId.description: The access-request ID. Required for action=approve/deny.

resourceId.description: The library/workflow ID. Required for action=request.

resourceType.description: Required for action=request (and action=list for a specific resource).

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. Defaults to your default workspace.

name: access_request
